svg.title: Muddy Faces — step 4: Add a face and wild hair
svg.desc: Press smooth stones lightly into the mud for eyes and a nose. A curved twig can make a smile. Arrange loose leaves, grass or approved flowers above the face for hair. Push decorations into the mud only, never into the bark.

text.font-family: Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Give the face its own expression
